cohort_role: gapped, and the cohort's over-citation case — NINE pinned clause snapshots against a compute() that implements one rate and one boolean. Chosen to test whether the convention distinguishes a node that CITES a body of law from a node that IMPLEMENTS it (SO #39(iii) OVER-CITED).
error_direction_rationale: The test is retention AT OR ABOVE a 5 percent floor, and every unexercised exemption removes an obligation rather than adding one. So an exempt securitization is measured against the floor anyway and reported RETENTION_NONCOMPLIANT — over-reporting, not a missed breach. compute({}) likewise fails closed. ⚠ The direction is favourable and the behaviour is still wrong: a confident non-compliance verdict over a transaction the rule exempts is a false positive with legal weight, not a harmless conservatism.

branches.branch: The sponsor retains an economic interest of at least 5 percent of the credit risk of the securitized assets.
The EU net-economic-interest requirement and its permitted retention forms.
The retained interest may not be hedged or sold.
The retainer may not be an entity established or operating for the sole purpose of securitising exposures.
A securitization collateralized solely by qualified residential mortgages carries no retention requirement.
branches.note: ⚠ CITATION DEFECT, found by this inventory. The kernel's own regulatory_basis string attributes the QRM exemption to 'Sec_.19'. The QRM exemption is 12 CFR 244.13; 244.19 is the GENERAL EXEMPTIONS section and is a different rule with a different content. The node pins a 244.19 snapshot and then labels its 244.13 behaviour with that number — exactly the wrong-locator class AUTHORING-STANDARD.md §3.1 exists to catch, in a payload string that ships on every MCP call. ⛔ Not fixed here: it is a kernel-string edit, which moves the digest and demands a re-prove (SO #36).

branches.branch: The part does not apply to securitizations collateralized solely by residential, multifamily or health-care facility mortgage assets insured or guaranteed by the United States, meeting the (b)(1)(i)-(ii) conditions.

Seven further general exemptions: certain agricultural loan securitizations; state and municipal securitizations; qualified scholarship funding bonds; pass-through resecuritizations (three conditions); first-pay-class securitizations (five conditions); seasoned loans (with a defined seasoning test at five years or 25 percent of original principal, and a two-year / 33 percent variant); and certain public utility securitizations.
branches.note: ⛔ FINDING. Seven branches, several multi-condition, none reachable. The seasoned-loan branch alone carries four numeric predicates the kernel has no input for.

branches.branch: Exemption for securitizations collateralized solely by US or agency obligations, by fully insured or guaranteed assets, or fully guaranteed as to timely payment.
A REDUCED retention requirement — not an exemption — for FFELP student-loan securitizations, tiered by guarantee level.
branches.note: ⛔ FINDING, and the one that inverts the node's declared error direction. (e) sets a retention percentage BELOW 5 percent for qualifying FFELP transactions. Because the kernel tests against a flat 5 percent it over-reports here like everywhere else — but the branch itself is the shape that would make a lower floor correct, and any future fix that reads (e) without reading the guarantee tiers would under-report. Recorded so that fix cannot be written blind.

branches.branch: Community-focused lending securitizations, including the 50 percent community-focused residential mortgage asset ratio and its measurement date; and securitizations of certain qualifying three-to-four unit residential mortgage loans, with depositor certifications and sponsor repurchase obligations.
The remaining pinned sections: qualifying commercial/CRE/auto asset rules, eligible ABCP conduits, open-market CLOs, and the associated disclosure and certification obligations.
branches.note: ⛔ FINDING — OVER-CITATION (SO #39(iii)). Six pinned snapshots whose content compute() does not exercise in any direction. They are cited, not implemented. The honest remedies are to drop the citations or to build the behaviour; recording them as unrepresented is the third option and the only one available inside this row's fence.

branches.branch: The measurement of total securitized exposure and of the retained amount.

assumption_of_use.source: 12 CFR 244.3(a) and the Art 6 measurement rules
assumption_of_use.owner: the CALLER. ⚠ compute({}) treats both as absent-equals-zero and returns RETENTION_NONCOMPLIANT — fail-closed, so the omission is safe here, unlike the same shape in art-396.
